newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan emerging markets bond index up.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan emerging markets bond index up.

text.p: J.P. Morgan & Co Inc said its Emerging Markets Bond Index Plus (EMBI+) rose 1.74 percent in February, its twelfth straight monthly gain.
The rise brought the index' total year-to-date return to 4.55 percent, it said.
EMBI+ tracks total returns for traded external debt instruments in the emerging markets.
J.P. Morgan said its Emerging Local Markets Index (ELMI) rose 0.26 percent in February, bringing its year-to-date gain to 1.44 percent.
ELMI tracks total returns for local-denominated money market instruments.
